2026-08-01.title: DeepMind Just Changed How AI Sees The World

sentences.text: Now, what if I told you that they promised you a model that is 99% smaller, a speck of dust comparatively, and yet this tiny guy can see? That sounds impossible.
sentences.zh: 如果我告訴你，他們承諾提供一個小 99% 的模型，相比之下只是一粒灰塵，然而這個小傢伙卻能看見呢？這聽起來不可能。

kw.zh: 「如果我告訴你...會怎麼樣？」(用於引出驚訝或不尋常的資訊)
「相比之下」(用於比較不同事物)

kw.w: yet this tiny guy can see
kw.zh: 「然而這個小傢伙卻能看見」(強調對比，"guy" 在此指模型，帶有擬人化色彩)
「聽起來不可能」(表達對某事難以置信或認為不可能)

sentences.text: And I think this is one of the most important architectural ideas in Gemma 4. It removes hundreds of millions of specialist parameters, and it blurs the boundary between perception and thinking.
sentences.zh: 我認為這是 Gemma 4 中最重要的架構理念之一。它移除了數億個專業參數，模糊了感知與思考之間的界線。

kw.zh: 「架構理念」(指設計或建構上的核心概念)

kw.w: removes hundreds of millions of specialist parameters
kw.zh: 「移除了數億個專業參數」(強調數量巨大和專業性，"specialist parameters" 指模型中特定功能的參數)

kw.w: blurs the boundary between A and B
kw.zh: 「模糊了 A 與 B 之間的界線」(表示 A 和 B 的區分變得不再清晰)
「感知與思考」(指接收訊息和處理資訊的兩種認知過程)

sentences.text: So, to everyone who is working on open models, wherever you are in the world, you are heroes. You help scientists, students, and millions of other people to do their work better.
sentences.zh: 所以，對於所有致力於開源模型的人，無論你身在何處，你們都是英雄。你們幫助科學家、學生以及數百萬其他人更好地完成他們的工作。

kw.zh: 「致力於；從事」(表示專注於某項工作或計畫)
「開源模型」(指公開其代碼、設計或參數的模型，允許他人自由使用、修改和分發)

kw.w: wherever you are in the world
kw.zh: 「無論你身在世界何處」(強調普遍性和廣泛性)
「英雄」(指因勇敢、成就或高尚品質而受人尊敬的人)
「數百萬其他人」(強調人數眾多)
「更好地完成他們的工作」(強調提升效率和質量)

2026-08-03.title: Did Anthropic just kill the indie hacker...?

sentences.text: A few days ago, Anthropic released Claude Opus 5, its fourth frontier model in eight weeks, which means Anthropic now slops out new models faster than JavaScript developers slop out new frameworks.
sentences.zh: 幾天前，Anthropic 發布了 Claude Opus 5，這是它八週內發布的第四個前沿模型，這意味著 Anthropic 現在推出新模型的速度比 JavaScript 開發者推出新框架還要快。

kw.zh: 前沿模型（指在AI領域中處於最領先、最先進水平的模型）
粗製濫造地生產/推出（帶有貶義，形容快速而馬虎的生產）

kw.zh: 超越/擊敗基準（表現遠超預期）
「信我哥就好」的基準（指缺乏嚴謹驗證、基於個人聲稱或非官方測試的基準）

sentences.text: But the trade-off is that the floor has never been more crowded and that trend will only continue as AI becomes cheaper and smarter while more normies realize that they can just vibe code software instead of paying someone else for it.
sentences.zh: 但權衡之下，底層競爭從未如此激烈，而且這個趨勢只會持續下去，因為 AI 變得更便宜、更智慧，同時越來越多普通人意識到他們可以輕鬆地自己寫軟體，而不是付錢給別人。

kw.w: the floor has never been more crowded
kw.zh: 底層競爭從未如此激烈/基礎門檻從未如此擁擠
輕鬆/隨性地寫程式（此處'vibe code'是一種非正式說法，意指以輕鬆、直觀的方式編寫程式碼）

sentences.zh: 但更重要的是，也更具變革性的是，由於不希望有任何條例，這種獨特的缺乏分區規劃無意中為這座城市成為一台不懈的成長機器開闢了一條道路。

2026-08-08.title: Where Is Love Stored in the Body?

sentences.text: You know that love can feel physical and leave your whole body buzzing. But expressions like these aren’t just poetic; they’re also a bit scientific, showing where the brain lights up when we experience it and even how it manifests between two people.
sentences.zh: 你知道愛可以讓人感到身體上的真實存在，讓你的全身都充滿活力。但像這樣的表達不只是詩意的，它們也帶有一些科學性，顯示出當我們體驗到愛時，大腦的哪些區域會被點亮，甚至愛如何在兩個人之間展現出來。

kw.zh: 感覺到身體上的真實存在

sentences.text: This allowed them to see not only if the body maps were different for different kinds of love, but also whether, across cultures, the more widespread it became.
sentences.zh: 這使他們能夠看到身體地圖是否因不同種類的愛而異，而且還能了解愛在不同文化中是否變得更為普遍。

kw.zh: 身體地圖 (指感知身體部位與情感的連結)

sentences.text: It doesn’t really exist in just one place, not in a single organ, a single brain region, or even squarely within an individual person; it’s less like a specific point on a map, and more like a whole landscape of feelings and connections.
sentences.zh: 它並非只存在於一個地方，不在單一器官、單一大腦區域，甚至不在單一個人身上；它更不像地圖上的一個特定點，而更像是一個由情感和連結組成的完整風景。

2026-08-10.title: The key to better conversations | Charles Duhigg

sentences.text: We've all been in those conversations where it feels like it's like two ships passing in the night, right? I'm talking about one thing, you're talking about a different thing, and like even though we're talking to each other, it doesn't
sentences.zh: 我們都曾有過這樣的對話，感覺就像兩艘船在黑夜中交錯而過，對吧？我說的是一件事，你說的是另一件事，即使我們彼此交談，卻沒有

kw.zh: 兩艘船在黑夜中交錯而過（比喻兩人擦肩而過、沒有交集或心意相通）

sentences.text: And so, what researchers have found is that we have to ask another kind of question. And it's the asking of the question that is the skill that helps us figure out what this conversation is about.
sentences.zh: 因此，研究人員發現我們必須問另一種問題。而正是提出這個問題的技巧，幫助我們弄清楚這次對話的重點是什麼。

kw.zh: 這次對話的重點是什麼

sentences.text: And so, one of the most critical skills for the practical conversation, for the what are we really talking about conversation to become a consistent supercommunicator is to ask deep questions.
sentences.zh: 因此，對於實用對話、對於我們真正在談論什麼的對話，要成為一個持續性的超級溝通者，其中一個最關鍵的技能就是提出深度問題。

sentences.zh: 五年過去了，現在那個機器人負責軍事。不用說，人工智慧發展得很快，但大家心裡最大的疑問還是那個。

sentences.text: It's 2,500 grad-school-level questions ranging from math to biology to social sciences to dozens of other subjects, each submitted and verified by experts at the top of their respective fields.

sentences.zh: 弄清楚這個橙色方塊是一個樂於助人的人，或者這種粉紅色物質像液體一樣流動，對人類來說可能很容易，但對人工智慧來說卻不是。

sentences.text: And that is why post-training can create a huge leap in performance even when the underlying model stays very similar. Remember this one because you are seeing one of the finest examples of it ever.

sentences.zh: 美國絕大多數的新建住宅是獨立式住宅，而其中絕大多數都以同樣廉價、妥協的方式開始：採用平地平板地基。

sentences.text: While American framing crews are typically led by career carpenters, much of each crew is often made up of relatively entry-level laborers since many of the tasks in framing can be done by those without a tremendous amount of experience.

sentences.text: By and large, though, American homes are not necessarily worse than their international equivalents when you consider their price. They just optimize for low upfront construction costs rather than low long-term maintenance and energy costs.
sentences.zh: 然而，總體而言，考慮到價格，美國住宅不一定比其國際同類產品差。它們只是優化了低前期建築成本，而不是低的長期維護和能源成本。

2026-08-15.title: Why China and America see AI differently | The Economist

sentences.text: And so what we really see is that China is right out there on the right hand side of the chart, you know, upwards of 80% of the Chinese population surveyed are very excited about the prospect of AI and they show much lower levels of nervousness.
sentences.zh: 我們看到中國在圖表的右側，你知道，超過80%的中國受訪人口對AI的前景感到非常興奮，並且表現出更低的緊張程度。

sentences.text: When I was in Shenzhen, which is often at the forefront of technology, the tech workers I spoke to are nervous; they're seeing their jobs transformed, and their roles are expanding to take on a lot more responsibilities, possibly due to AI's influence.
sentences.zh: 當我在深圳時，那裡通常處於科技的最前沿，我與之交談的科技工作者感到緊張；他們看到自己的工作被轉型，且角色正在擴展以承擔更多職責，這可能歸因於AI的影響。

kw.w: take on a lot more responsibilities

sentences.text: But speaking to government advisers, they are really thinking this through and they're struggling because they're caught between wanting to assuage these anxious workers and the public, but also they don't want to stifle innovation.
sentences.zh: 但與政府顧問們交流後，他們正在認真思考這件事，而且他們左右為難，因為他們一方面想安撫這些焦慮的工人和大眾，另一方面又不想扼殺創新。
